{{Top|leg}}
A '''dataform''' was an official form that was required to be filled out by [[Pilgrim (Ugor)|Pilgrims]] to the [[Paradise system/Legends|Paradise system]] upon entry. Through the use of a bribe known as a "tool tax," visitors to the Paradise system could retain their weapons by creating creative names and descriptions for their hand weapons.
